platform_indicator_name: Maternal mortality ratio (Maternal disorders, GBD cause 366)

Maternal disorders mortality captures comprehensive maternal deaths as defined by the World Health Organization.' | Late maternal deaths (p.587): 'We ran a single-parameter model in DisMod-MR 2.1 to estimate the proportion of all maternal deaths that were late. extra_json: {"interval_rule": "Intervals come from GBD's draws for each estimate. A sum or other combination of rows (causes, locations, ages, sexes) has no GBD interval: added lower and upper bounds are not one, so show the combined value with no interval. Overlapping intervals do not show two values are equal, nor separate ones that they differ; GBD publishes no test of a difference between locations, causes or groups, so 'no meaningful difference' is not a GBD finding. A change over time is tested by get_percent_change's own interval."}
